result.topic_en: Calculations on solving a third-order linear ODE with polynomial coefficients by a definite integral (Laplace/Euler-type kernel) representation $v=\int w(x-z)^{\mu-1}dz$, the adjoint equation for $w$, followed by transformations of a second-order equation $\Theta(\lambda)v''+\tfrac32\Theta' v'+\dots$ via substitutions $u=v\Theta^\mu$ and $u=e^{g\sqrt{\lambda+\alpha}}v$, with a series trial solution.
result.transcription:
$\zeta_0\frac{\partial^3 v}{\partial x^3}+\zeta_1\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2}+\zeta_2\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\zeta_3=0$
$v=\int w(x-z)^{\mu-1}\partial z\quad \int\left(\zeta_0\,\mu(\mu-1)(\mu-2)(x-z)^{\mu-3}+\zeta_1\,\mu(\mu-1)(x-z)^{\mu-2}+\zeta_2\,\mu(x-z)^{\mu-1}+\zeta_3\right)w\,\partial z$
$\zeta_0=g_0+g_0'(x-z)+g_0''\frac{(x-z)^2}{2}+g_0'''\frac{(x-z)^3}{6}$
$\zeta_1=g_1+g_1'(x-z)+g_1''\frac{(x-z)^2}{2}$
$\zeta_2=g_2+g_2'(x-z)$
$\zeta_3=g_3$
$w\left(g_3+g_2'\mu+g_1''\frac{\mu(\mu-1)}{2}+g_0'''\frac{\mu(\mu-1)(\mu-2)}{6}\right)$
$+\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(w\left(g_2+(\mu-1)g_1'+\frac{(\mu-1)(\mu-2)}{2}g_0''\right)\right)$
$+\frac{\partial^2}{\partial z^2}\left(w\left(g_1+(\mu-2)g_0'\right)\right)$
$+\frac{\partial^3}{\partial z^3}(w g_0)$
$g_0\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial z^3}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial z^2}\left(3g_0'+g_1+(\mu+1)g_0'\right)+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\left(g_2+(\mu+1)g_1'+\frac{\mu(\mu+1)}{2}g_0''\right)+w\left(g_3+(\mu+1)g_2'+\frac{\mu(\mu+1)}{2}g_1''+\frac{\mu(\mu+1)(\mu-1)}{6}g_0'''\right)$
$g_3+(\mu+1)g_2'+\frac{\mu(\mu+1)}{2}g_1''+\frac{\mu(\mu+1)(\mu-1)}{6}g_0'''$
$\nu+1\quad(\nu+1)\mu+1\quad(\nu+1)\frac{\mu(\mu+1)}{2}\quad\mu(\mu+1)(\nu+\mu)$

$u=v\,\Theta(\lambda)^\mu$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\lambda}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial\lambda}\Theta(\lambda)^\mu+v\mu\,\Theta(\lambda)^{\mu-1}\Theta'\lambda$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\lambda^2}=\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\lambda^2}\Theta\lambda^\mu+2\frac{\partial v}{\partial\lambda}\mu\,\Theta(\lambda)^{\mu-1}\Theta'\lambda+v\left(\mu\,\Theta\lambda^{\mu-1}\Theta''\lambda+\mu(\mu-1)\Theta(\lambda)^{\mu-2}\Theta'(\lambda)^2\right)$
$\Theta(\lambda)\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\lambda^2}+\frac32\Theta'\lambda\frac{\partial v}{\partial\lambda}+v\left(\frac12\Theta''(\lambda)+g\lambda\lambda+h\lambda+k\right)=0$

methods.what: Representation of solution of third-order linear ODE as definite integral with kernel $(x-z)^{\mu-1}$
Taylor expansion of polynomial coefficients about z
Adjoint differential equation for the kernel weight w via integration by parts
Exponential substitution to remove irregular singular behaviour
Series trial solution and coefficient determination
